contracts: The seven handlers retain exact selector, template, allocator, gate, palette, special-field, and facing-byte behavior from the recorded static decompilation.
The Type-0x0B and Type-0x0C handlers are named as level-event creations, while Type-0x0F, Type-0x16, and Type-0x36 retain runtime-template-qualified interaction identities.
The Type-0x0F selector-0x16 variant is distinguished by its post-allocation facing-byte write.
evidence: Exact handler bodies and INTERACTION_HANDLER_TABLE membership
limitations: No user-facing scene or object identity is claimed for these handlers.
conclusion: The late level-object and interaction family now has stable creation identities while preserving historical aliases and exact direct side-effect contracts.
